# Hyderabad Eats (Mapping HYD)

> Free Hyderabad food map and community-voted rankings for restaurants, cafes, biryani, and local spots.

## Product
- Name: Hyderabad Eats / Mapping HYD Eats
- Site: https://eats.mapmyhyd.com/
- Parent: https://mapmyhyd.com/
- Coverage: 3,400+ eateries across Hyderabad
- Free, no signup required to browse

## How rankings work
Weekly community votes on the map, plus an all-time Google-review baseline on each ranking page.
